description: This file defines API endpoints for managing events and their attendees using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting events, as well as listing, adding, and removing attendees for specific events.

classes.name: MessageResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a message response with a message string.

classes.name: LinkPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model for linking or unlinking an attendee to/from an event, containing attendee_id.

methods.name: List[Event] list_events()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all events.

methods.name: Event create_event(payload: EventCreate)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new event.

methods.name: Event get_event( event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an event by ID.

methods.name: Event update_event( event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), payload: EventUpdate = ..., )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing event by ID.

methods.name: MessageResponse delete_event( event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an event by ID.

methods.name: List[Attendee] list_event_attendees(event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list attendees of a specific event.

methods.name: Event add_attendee_to_event( payload: LinkPayload, event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add (link) an attendee to an event.

methods.name: Event remove_attendee_from_event( payload: LinkPayload, event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove (unlink) an attendee from an event.

ctags.signature: ( payload: LinkPayload, event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), )

ctags.signature: (event_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the event"))
